digest.component_or_area: git workflow wrapper for Gerrit commits
propositions: git commit --amend -F/-m replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new id and create a duplicate change instead of a patchset
prepare-commit-msg hook cannot distinguish an amend -F from a fresh -F commit, making hook-based prevention infeasible
a make amend-msg wrapper should extract HEAD's Change-Id, preserve it while updating the message via git interpret-trailers, and fail loudly if HEAD has no Change-Id
the wrapper must be documented as the standard path for rewritten commit messages in AGENTS.md, with a warning that --amend -m/-F creates duplicates
test coverage must prove the wrapper preserves Change-Id equality and the naive form loses it, via a fake hook counter in .git that detects re-stamping
